ordinary_execution_semantics: All present-symbol opening marks and gap/event/timeout exits precede one shared min(cash,equity) risk snapshot; all admissions precede every current-bar high/low.
A missing exact quote expires entry; an owned event-exit remains pending until first available quote, with adverse gap-stop priority. This never changes the event population.

Actual account uses snapshot financing. Additional long spread accrues at entry, short spread at exit; half-entry/half-exit midpoint fees accrue on their respective sides. No-positive-credit stress deducts positive financing at its recorded boundary. Stress never changes actual sizes.

Calendar gates use changes in marked end-of-year account equity, including accrued stress and financing; realized cash attribution is separately reported. This accounts for any cross-year owned exposure.
Price-to-stop risk uses outward tick rounding and basic liquidation-side stop validity; unavailable exact historical margin/stops/freeze/commission remain optimistic proxy limits until native.
No old strategy source is imported or executed; only fresh ordinary production source and normal integrated ledger reconciliation. Python compilation passed; no tests/checker infrastructure.
